_meta.purpose: IR-disclosed CSM metrics for 동양생명 (KR0087) FY2026 1H, extracted from downloader-delivered raw IR files. NOT yet integrated into root masters (NB_CSM_multiple.json / CSM_waterfall.json) -- integration is a separate follow-up.
_meta.unit_conversion: Source unit = 십억원 (KRW billion, xlsx header '(단위 십억원)' / PDF '(십억원)'). Repo master convention = 억원 (KRW 100-million). 1 십억원 = 10억원, so eok = krw_bn * 10. Both are recorded below for traceability.
_meta.output_path_is_new_convention: No existing data/ir/*/parsed/ directory convention was found in this repo prior to this file (checked via glob before writing). This introduces data/ir/<FY_Q>/parsed/<KR>_<name>/<file>.json as a sibling to the existing data/ir/<FY_Q>/raw/<KR>_<name>/ layout. A human should confirm this matches other IR-ingestion output conventions before this pattern is reused for the other 12 IR sources due mid-August.

nb_csm_multiple.note: 동양생명 IR discloses TWO distinct 'CSM 배수/Margin' tables (xlsx sheet 'CSM'), with DIFFERENT denominators. Neither uses KIDI's 월납월초보험료 (the denominator scripts/build_nb_csm_multiple.py uses for the DART-sourced master) -- see denominator_discrepancy below.

variant_A_vs_APE.definition: 신계약CSM / 신계약APE (Annualized Premium Equivalent). Fraction, NOT a 'times' multiple like the repo master (values are ~0.4-1.0, i.e. CSM is 40-100% of APE).
variant_A_vs_APE.source: xlsx 'CSM' rows 37-41, section header 'APE 대비 신계약 CSM 배수 (New Business CSM Margin compared to New Business APE)'

variant_B_vs_monthly_initial_premium.definition: 신계약CSM / 월초P (Monthly initial premium) -- conceptually the SAME basis as the repo's 월납월초보험료 (both = 'monthly initial premium'), but 동양생명's own internal 월초P figure is NOT the same series as KIDI's 월납 초회 that scripts/build_nb_csm_multiple.py uses. This is the directly-disclosed 'times' multiple comparable in magnitude to other companies' IR-disclosed multiples in data/ir/disclosed_csm_multiple.json (range ~5-22x).
variant_B_vs_monthly_initial_premium.source: xlsx 'CSM' rows 44-51, section header '월초P 대비 신계약 CSM 배수 (New Business CSM Margin compared to Monthly initial premium)'

implied_premium_base_backcalculated_NOT_.note: 월초P absolute krw value is NOT disclosed anywhere in the PDF or xlsx -- only the ratio is shown. Back-calculated here as CSM/multiple purely for comparison; this is a derived number, not a source figure.

nb_csm_multiple.denominator_discrepancy_vs_root_master: Root NB_CSM_multiple.json (DART CSM numerator + KIDI 월납월초보험료 denominator) has KR0087 2026.1Q: 신계약CSM배수_연누계=9.463 (월납월초보험료_연누계=99.8207억원). IR's own 월초P-basis multiple for the same quarter (FY26.1Q) is 8.1462x, implying a denominator of ~116.0억원 -- about 16% LARGER than KIDI's 99.82억원 for what should be the same quarter. Numerator (CSM) matches almost exactly (944.6 vs 944.65억원) so the gap is entirely in the premium denominator definition/scope. Do NOT treat the IR multiple and the master multiple as interchangeable without reconciling what 동양생명's internal '월초P' includes/excludes vs KIDI's INCOS 월납초회 category.
nb_csm_multiple.not_disclosed: No 'CSM 배수' or 'New Business CSM multiple' figure appears anywhere in the PDF presentation itself (grepped full extracted text -- zero matches for 배수/월납/환산/multiple). Both multiple variants above come ONLY from the xlsx factsheet's 'CSM' sheet.
